formValues.goals:
Ship the core feature reliably.
Keep the codebase small and readable.
Green CI on every push.
formValues.non_goals:
No multi-tenancy.
No heavy framework abstraction.
No custom UI framework.
formValues.stack_preset: Microsoft data & BI (Fabric / Power BI / Power Platform)
formValues.language: DAX, Power Query M, Power Fx, T-SQL, PySpark
formValues.framework: Microsoft Fabric, Power BI (PBIP: TMDL + PBIR), Power Platform (solutions, canvas apps, Power Automate)
formValues.test_runner: pytest for Python/PySpark logic; ./scripts/validate.sh for source-format checks
formValues.formatter: ruff format (Python only: Fabric notebooks, TMDL, PBIR and solution files are never reformatted)
formValues.typechecker: ./scripts/validate.sh models report (TMDL structure + PBIR schema, offline)
formValues.database: Microsoft Fabric OneLake (lakehouse, warehouse) and Dataverse
formValues.deployment: Microsoft Fabric workspaces and Power Platform environments (Dev, Test, Prod) on Azure
formValues.naming: Business-friendly names for semantic-model objects, snake_case in Python; names are defined in SPEC.md.
formValues.test_philosophy: Tests alongside the code they cover
formValues.architecture: Contract-first: SPEC.md defines the tables, columns, measures, environment variables, connection references and flows that Fabric, the semantic model, reports and Power Platform share.
formValues.state_mgmt: Dataverse holds transactional state, Fabric OneLake holds analytical state; flows never bulk-copy data into Fabric.
formValues.auth: Microsoft Entra ID: service principals or managed identities through OIDC federated credentials; no secrets in the repository.
formValues.observability: Fabric monitoring hub, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Power Platform analytics.
formValues.common_instructions:
Contract first: update SPEC.md before renaming or removing any table, column, measure, environment variable or connection reference, then update every consumer.
Run ./scripts/validate.sh after edits under fabric/ or power-platform/. It checks structure only, never DAX or M.
Live-tenant commands (pac auth/import/export/check, fab, az) need a human: ask first.
Never commit tenant IDs, workspace GUIDs, environment URLs, connection IDs or credentials: use environment variables, connection references and deployment settings.
formValues.known_gotchas:
A .platform logicalId is the item's identity: never change it, and give a copied item folder a new logicalId and displayName.
Hand-editing extracted Power Platform solution files is unsupported except in specific cases; round-trip through a dev environment instead.
pac solution pack exits 0 even when a component's files are missing; validate.sh fails on that message, so do not trust a bare pac exit code.
formValues.pointers:
@docs/architecture.md — system diagram and boundaries
@docs/workflow.md — contribution workflow
